reply.rationale: No defensible multi-morpheme paradigm is evidenced in the supplied codebook. The symbols 1–14 behave as opaque indexed procedures rather than compositions of a shared stem plus literal numbers: their meanings are not predictable from a common frame with substituting fillers, and the digits do not contribute stable count meanings across the family. The standalone items R/T/Bo, g/m/f, near/on/ea are meaningful lexical labels, but there are no attested composite codes in which they recur as parts of larger symbols, so no construction entries can be licensed. Because the evidence does not support any segmentation with compositional predictability and substitution classes, the safest analysis is a flat lexicon.
